create_enquiry.title: Create an enquiry
create_enquiry.description: Push a lead into Ascora's Enquiries: contact and company, address, work description, lead source and custom fields -- e.g. from a website form. Staff then assign it or convert it to a quote or job.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as [{fieldName, fieldValue}]; the definitions must already exist under Administration > Custom Fields.

search_customers.title: Search customers
search_customers.description: Search customers by free text (number, email, phone, names), phone across phone and mobile, customer type, lead source, assigned user, or site/billing type. Paged.

filter_text.description: Free-text match on customer number, email, phone, mobile, billing name and contact names.

phone_number.description: Match against both phone and mobile.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

get_customer.title: Get a customer
get_customer.description: Read one customer by id: names, contact details, hold flags, street and postal addresses, type, lead source, billing customer, assigned user and custom fields.

save_customer.title: Create or update a customer
save_customer.description: Create a customer, or update one when customer_id is given (fails if that id is not found). Customer type and lead source are created if they do not exist.

customer_id.description: Id of an existing customer to update; a new customer is created when omitted.

billing_customer_on_hold.description: Put the billing customer on hold.

customer_type.description: Customer type name, e.g. Domestic; created if it does not exist.

lead_source.description: Lead source name, e.g. Google; created if it does not exist.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as [{fieldName, fieldValue}]; the definitions must already exist under Administration > Custom Fields.

search_contacts.title: Search contacts
search_contacts.description: Search contacts across customers by free text (names, email, phone, mobile; contains match) or exact phone number (spaces ignored). Paged.

filter_text.description: Contains-match on first/last name, email, phone and mobile.

phone_number.description: Exact match on phone or mobile, spaces ignored.

list_customer_contacts.title: List a customer's contacts
list_customer_contacts.description: List the contacts of one customer with names, email, phone, mobile, fax, role and default flag.

get_contact.title: Get a contact
get_contact.description: Read one contact by id: customer, names, email, phone numbers, role and whether it is the customer's default contact.

save_contact.title: Create or update a contact
save_contact.description: Create a contact on a customer, or update one when contact_id is given. The contact role is looked up by name and created if missing.

contact_id.description: Id of an existing contact to update.

customer_id.description: The customer the contact belongs to.

default_contact.description: Make this the customer's default contact.

contact_role.description: Contact role name; created if it does not exist.

search_supplies.title: Search supplies
search_supplies.description: Search basic price items -- materials and services -- by text (part number, supplier part, description, annotation, category), category, or favourites only. Returns cost and sell prices.

filter_text.description: Words to match in part number, description, annotation and category name.

search_kits.title: Search kits
search_kits.description: Search kits -- packages of supplies and labour -- by text, category, or favourites only, with pricing method and prices.

filter_text.description: Words to match in part number, description, annotation and category name.

list_inventory_categories.title: List inventory categories
list_inventory_categories.description: List the categories supplies and kits are grouped under, filtered by name, category number (1 or 2) or top-level only.

filter_text.description: Text to match in the category name.

list_standard_sections.title: List standard quote sections
list_standard_sections.description: List the standard sections that can be added to a quote or job, with display order.

list_standard_stages.title: List standard quote stages
list_standard_stages.description: List the standard stages that can be added to a quote or job, with display order.

list_labour_roles.title: List labour roles
list_labour_roles.description: List the labour roles (types of labour with an hourly rate) that can be added to quotes and jobs.

get_quote.title: Get a quote
get_quote.description: Read a quote by its number (use dashes for a section, e.g. Q1234-01): name, description, status, dates, totals, pricing method, address, job type and customers.

quote_number.description: The quote number, e.g. Q57, or Q1234-01 for a section.

search_quotes.title: Search quotes
search_quotes.description: Search quotes by text (number, name, address), status (default OPEN), job type, assigned user, customer name and creation date range. Paged, 250 per page by default.

filter_text.description: Partial match on quote number, name or address.

quote_status.description: Status to filter to; OPEN (in progress or sent) when omitted.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

customer_name.description: Partial match on site or billing customer name.

start_date.description: Only quotes created on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only quotes created on or before this date.

create_quote.title: Create a quote
create_quote.description: Create a quotation for a site customer, optionally adding supplies, kits, labour and write-ins in the same call. With pricing_method SECTIONS, pass child_quotes (each with its own items) to build sections at once; parent-level items are then ignored.
create_quote.notes: Give site_customer_id or site_customer_name; Ascora requires a site customer.

pricing_method.description: Pricing method; Time and Materials when omitted.

total_inc_tax.description: Fixed total including tax; ex-tax is calculated.

address_line1.description: Site address line 1; the site customer's address when omitted.

site_customer_id.description: Site customer id. Give this or site_customer_name.

site_customer_name.description: Site customer name (company name, or first and last name for an individual).

billing_customer_id.description: Billing customer id; the site's billing customer when omitted.

job_type_id.description: Job type id; the default job type when omitted.

job_type_name.description: Job type name, e.g. Commercial Maintenance.

quote_labour_items.description: Labour roles to add, each {Id, QuantityAdded}.

quote_write_ins.description: Write-in items (not in the price list), each {partNumber, description, annotation, unitCostExTax, unitSellPrice, sellPriceIncludesTax, quantity, mustBeOrdered}.

child_quotes.description: Sections for a SECTIONS quote, each {quoteName, quoteSupplies, quoteKits, quoteLabourItems, quoteWriteIns}.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as [{fieldName, fieldValue}]; the definitions must already exist under Administration > Custom Fields.

add_quote_supplies.title: Add supplies to a quote
add_quote_supplies.description: Add supply items (materials or services from the price list) to a quote or one of its sections.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

supplies.description: Supplies (ids from search_supplies) to add, each {Id, QuantityAdded}.

add_quote_kits.title: Add kits to a quote
add_quote_kits.description: Add kits (from search_kits) to a quote or one of its sections.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

kits.description: Kits (ids from search_kits) to add, each {Id, QuantityAdded}.

add_quote_write_ins.title: Add write-in items to a quote
add_quote_write_ins.description: Add items that are not in the price list, with part number, description, cost, sell price and quantity. The default write-in category is applied.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

write_ins.description: Write-in items (not in the price list), each {partNumber, description, annotation, unitCostExTax, unitSellPrice, sellPriceIncludesTax, quantity, mustBeOrdered}.

add_quote_labour.title: Add labour to a quote
add_quote_labour.description: Add labour hours by labour role (ids from list_labour_roles) to a quote or section; QuantityAdded is hours.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

labour_items.description: Labour roles, QuantityAdded in hours, to add, each {Id, QuantityAdded}.

clear_quote_items.title: Clear items from a quote
clear_quote_items.description: Remove all supplies, kits and/or labour from a quote (or one section, by its full number).

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

add_quote_sections.title: Add sections to a quote
add_quote_sections.description: Add child sections to a section-based quote; each section then carries its own items and the parent sums them.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

update_quote_status.title: Update a quote's status
update_quote_status.description: Move a quote to IN-PROGRESS, SENT-TO-CUSTOMER, LOST (with a reason) or WON. Marking it WON creates the job and returns its id.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

reason_for_loss.description: Reason recorded when the status is LOST.

delete_quote.title: Delete a quote or section
delete_quote.description: Delete an In Progress quote, or one of its sections (later sections are renumbered and totals recalculated). Quotes sent to the client cannot be deleted.

quote_number.description: The full quote number, including section/stage numbering for a section, e.g. Q1234 or Q1234.01.

add_note.title: Add a note
add_note.description: Add a note to an enquiry, job, quotation, invoice or customer.

created_by_name.description: Name shown as the note's author, e.g. External System.

get_job.title: Get a job
get_job.description: Read a job by its full number: name, description, work undertaken, status (0 New ... 8 Closed), dates, totals, pricing method, address, job type and customers.

get_job_labour.title: Get a job's labour
get_job_labour.description: List the labour lines on a job: who, role, hours, rate, totals, chargeable and invoiced flags.

get_job_timesheets.title: Get a job's timesheets
get_job_timesheets.description: List the timesheet entries recorded against a job: user, start and end, hours, cost and pay rates, meal breaks and payroll status.

search_jobs.title: Search jobs
search_jobs.description: Search jobs by text (number, name, address), status (default open), job type, assigned user, customer name and creation date range. Paged, 250 per page by default.

filter_text.description: Partial match on job number, name or address.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

customer_name.description: Partial match on site or billing customer name.

start_date.description: Only jobs created on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only jobs created on or before this date.

create_job.title: Create a job
create_job.description: Create a job for a site customer with name, description, pricing method, totals, order numbers, address and job type. Omitted address, billing customer and job type fall back to the site customer's and defaults.
create_job.notes: Give site_customer_id or site_customer_name; Ascora requires a site customer.

pricing_method.description: Pricing method; Time and Materials when omitted.

total_inc_tax.description: Fixed total including tax; ex-tax is calculated.

address_line1.description: Site address line 1; the site customer's address when omitted.

site_customer_id.description: Site customer id. Give this or site_customer_name.

site_customer_name.description: Site customer name (company name, or first and last name for an individual).

billing_customer_id.description: Billing customer id; the site's billing customer when omitted.

job_type_id.description: Job type id; the default job type when omitted.

job_type_name.description: Job type name, e.g. Commercial Maintenance.

completed_date.description: Completion date-time, for recording finished work.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as [{fieldName, fieldValue}]; the definitions must already exist under Administration > Custom Fields.

search_suppliers.title: Search suppliers
search_suppliers.description: Search suppliers by partial name or number, or exact business number (e.g. ABN, spaces ignored). Paged.

get_supplier.title: Get a supplier
get_supplier.description: Read one supplier by id: number, name, business number, contact, phone numbers, email, addresses and invoice terms.

save_supplier.title: Create or update a supplier
save_supplier.description: Create a supplier, or update one when supplier_id is given.

supplier_id.description: Id of an existing supplier to update; a new supplier is created when omitted.

create_supplier_invoice.title: Create a supplier invoice or credit note
create_supplier_invoice.description: Record a supplier invoice (or credit note, type CREDIT) with its lines. Attachments can be added afterwards in Ascora using the returned id.

tracking_number.description: Supplier's invoice or credit note number.

supplier_id.description: Supplier id. Give this or supplier_name.

reference.description: Purchase order or job number it relates to.

is_expense.description: Treat as an expense in Ascora (default no).

search_supplier_invoices.title: Search supplier invoices
search_supplier_invoices.description: Search supplier invoices and credit notes by supplier name, tracking number, invoice date range, or only those not yet sent to the accounting package. Paged.

to_be_sent_to_accounts_only.description: Only invoices not yet pushed to the accounting package.

get_supplier_invoice.title: Get a supplier invoice
get_supplier_invoice.description: Read one supplier invoice by id with its supplier, dates, type, account code, totals, sent-to-accounts flag and lines.

mark_supplier_invoices_sent.title: Mark supplier invoices as sent to accounts
mark_supplier_invoices_sent.description: Mark supplier invoices as pushed to the accounting package so they drop out of search_supplier_invoices(to_be_sent_to_accounts_only).

get_invoices_to_send.title: Get customer invoices to send to accounts
get_invoices_to_send.description: List customer invoices dated before a date that have not yet been sent to the accounting package, with lines, customer and site details and optional job, invoice and customer custom fields. Only needed without a direct Xero/MYOB/QuickBooks link; mark them afterwards or they come back.

prior_to_date.description: Only invoices dated before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

include_job_custom_fields.description: Include the related job's custom fields.

include_customer_custom_fields.description: Include the billing customer's custom fields.

mark_invoices_sent.title: Mark customer invoices as sent to accounts
mark_invoices_sent.description: Mark customer invoices as sent to the accounting package so get_invoices_to_send stops returning them.

get_payments_to_send.title: Get payments to send to accounts
get_payments_to_send.description: List payments not yet sent to the accounting package (on invoices already sent), with amount, surcharge, receipt number and invoice.

prior_to_date.description: Only payments before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

create_payment.title: Record a payment
create_payment.description: Record a payment against a customer invoice by invoice number and payment method name. Rejected when the payment plus surcharge exceeds the balance.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number the payment applies to.

payment_method.description: Name of the payment method in Ascora, e.g. EFT.

mark_payments_sent.title: Mark payments as sent to accounts
mark_payments_sent.description: Mark payments as sent to the accounting package so get_payments_to_send stops returning them.

list_webhooks.title: List webhook subscriptions
list_webhooks.description: List the account's webhook subscriptions. This is the connector's verification endpoint; the guide does not document its response shape.

create_webhook.title: Subscribe to a webhook event
create_webhook.description: Have Ascora POST to a url when an event happens -- enquiry, customer, contact, quote, job, invoice or booking created or modified, or a quote/job status change.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook subscription
delete_webhook.description: Remove a webhook subscription by the id create_webhook returned.
